prompt:
Build a profile card about yourself: a photo, your name, a short bio and your hobbies, styled with CSS.

Every line is typed by hand, one step at a time. A step's checks tick as soon as your code is right.

steps.title: Link your stylesheet
steps.instructions:
Your page and your styles live in two files. A browser only uses a CSS file when the HTML points to it.

Inside `<head>`, under the `<title>`, add:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
```
steps.hint: `<link>` has no closing tag. Check that `href` is exactly `style.css`.
